PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "improve general fitness and strength safely post-MI"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Cardio & Mobility":
